{{Top|leg}}
'''The Vigil''' was a secret organization based in the [[Mestra system/Legends|Mestra system]]. It was organized by the children of the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] families that had been sent away for education, and had returned to the system. Their goal was to fight the [[Minos-Mestra Corporation]] and correct the injustices visited upon the [[Miner/Legends|miners]], but was in truth little more than a rich boy's club that talked and did little else.<ref name="GG6-1">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>
